newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Banerj auction delayed until Thursday.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Banerj auction delayed until Thursday.

text.p: The privatization auction of Rio de Janeiro state bank Banerj has been delayed until Thursday 1000 local/1300 GMT, a Rio de Janeiro Stock Exchange spokeswoman said.
The auction, which hinges on Senate approval of a deal resolving Banerj's pension-related debts, was originally scheduled to take place Tuesday.

The Senate is expected to vote on the matter Thursday, according to a spokesman for the Senate economic affairs committee, which has to approve the deal first before it goes to the floor of the Senate.
Under the debt deal awaiting Senate approval, Rio state would assume Banerj's debts to its pension fund, which would be covered by a 3.09 billion real loan from Caixa Economica Federal CEF).
Four banks -- Bradesco, Banco Itau, BCN and Cia de Investimentos Latino-Americana, owned by a foreign bank and represented by local Banco Pactual -- signed up for the auction.
Banerj is due to be sold off with a minimum price of 310 million reais in a closed-envelope auction. ((--Simona de Logu, Rio de Janeiro newsroom, 5521 507 4151))
